issue.title: Show detached/joined ToolRuns in the TUI: ⚒ chip on joining monitor rows, detached/joined badges in the Runs card and Tools pane

task_type_fields.proposal:
Surface inline-then-escalate state in the ACE TUI:

- a `⚒` ToolRun chip on the row of a monitor that joined a detached run (the monitor's meta carries `monitor_tool_run_id` plus `monitor_tool_run_joined: true`, set by src/sase/monitor/start.py);
- "detached" and "joined" badges for ToolRuns in the Agents-tab Runs card and the Admin Tools pane, matching the CLI's `sase tool show` lines ("detached by agent X (stopped when that agent's turn ends unless joined)" / "joined by monitor Y at T", rendered in src/sase/tool/_query_shared.py `_format_detached` / `_format_join`).

`sase tool show -j` already carries `starter` and `join` through the core envelope. If a TUI projection needs them (briefs, live glance, node summaries), add them to the sase-core `tool_run` projections first per the Rust core boundary, then render them in Python. Note related bead sase-1bi: monitor agent-scan wires do not carry `monitor_tool_run_id` yet, so a joined monitor's chip may depend on that fix.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: TUI changes were an explicit non-goal of epic sase-1cx (plan:202609/tool_run_escalation.md, "Non-goals: TUI changes"; the core phase kept projections unchanged), and the plan's landing section lists these TUI surfaces as an expected follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1cx made detached and monitor-joined ToolRuns the default agent path but kept TUI changes out of scope, so the TUI cannot tell an escalated or joined run from any other hand-off; its landing plan lists these surfaces as an expected follow-up.
